items.title: San José State Football Weekly Press Conference (New Mexico)
items.summary: Head Coach Ken Niumatalolo, Offensive Coordinator Craig Stutzmann, and Defensive Coordinator Bojay Filimoeatu preview their game at home against New Mexico on Saturday at 1:00 p.m. on MW+ and NBC Sports Bay Area. Please join MW+ for same-day access to press conferences.

items.title: Sink or Swim: Fred Warner Rehabs with SJSU Swimming (ESPN)
items.summary: ESPN's Monday Night Football tells the story of 49ers star Fred Warner as he rehabbed his devastating injury with SJSU swimming and head coach Sage Hopkins as he prepared for the 2026 season.
